text:
Mae: heads-up — pushed an RBAC tweak to private control plane role mapping an hour ago. several onprem customers report admin console 403s.

Jay: detected it while triaging a ticket from AcmeCorp. error from control plane: `403 Forbidden: missing condition 'aws:SourceVpc'`

Eli: wait what changed? we only intended to tighten vpc allowlist checks for private deployments. did the role-binding logic start enforcing `vpc:SourceVpc` in policy?

Mae: yes, new role-refactor introduced a condition check in the delegated-role binding generator. snippet from generator: ```json
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"vpc:SourceVpc": "${tenant_vpc}"}}
```

Sara: that condition is too strict for onprem customers that authenticate via SSO and hit the control plane from feeder-proxies. their source IPs are NATed, not the tenant_vpc id. ops-bot logs show 403 + KMS decrypt fails for service tokens.

ops-bot: audit-log: {"ts":"2024-06-03T12:01:12Z","principal":"svc-account/onprem-admin","action":"AssumeRole","result":"Denied","reason":"ConditionMismatch: vpc:SourceVpc"}

Victor: KMS bit sounds weird — can you paste the KMS error?

Mae: KMS error from control-plane: `AccessDeniedException: not authorized to decrypt with key arn:aws:kms:... because request does not match kms:ViaService condition`

Jay: chain looks like: 1) role binding requires vpc condition -> 2) callcarrying service principal fails assumeRole -> 3) service can't call KMS to unwrap tenant keys -> 4) admin consoles get 403.

Eli: reproduce steps I used: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <onprem-admin-token>" https://private-controlplane.acme.example.com/api/v1/tenants/123/console
# -> 403
# check audit: jq '.message' /var/log/controlplane/audit.log | grep 123
```

Sara: quick mitigation: revert role-refactor that adds the strict `vpc:SourceVpc` condition and roll forward a patch that validates the source via `aws:SourceIp` OR allowlist the feeder-proxy service principal.

Mae: I already put a rollback PR open: `revert: role-binding vpc condition` and tagged eng-oncall. planning a hotfix deploy in 20m if no objections.

Victor: +1 from infra. also we should add an integration test that simulates NAT/proxy flows and ensures KMS `kms:ViaService` conditions still match.

Jay: can we scope a follow-up: (a) add audit rule for any `AssumeRole` denied with condition mismatch, (b) add a dashboard alert, (c) patch docs for private deployments about feeder-proxies.

Eli: I'll own (a) and (b). will add a simple LogQL alert for denied assumeRole with `ConditionMismatch`.

Sara: I'll update customer-communication draft for impacted tenants and include a timeline.

Mae: deploying rollback now. ping here when rollback is live and when we see successful `AssumeRole` + KMS decrypt in audit. :pray:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id jb-47291) by mae at 2024-06-03T12:15:40Z

Jay: seeing initial health checks green. AcmeCorp reported console access restored at 12:21.

Victor: follow-up ticket created: SEC-priv-372 - "role-binding vpc condition regression & KMS interplay". assigned to mae.

Mae: thanks all. follow-up plan: patch generator to only add `vpc:SourceVpc` when tenant traffic hits control plane directly; otherwise add `StringLike` for feeder proxies and ensure KMS key policy uses `kms:ViaService` correctly. I'll post the PR link here once ready.

Eli: nice catch, folks. short convo but high signal.

Mae: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/891 (WIP)
